description:
Mycosynth Lattice causes all permanents to become artifacts, and March of the Machines causes all noncreature artifacts to become artifact creatures with power and toughness each equal to their mana value.
This causes all noncreature artifacts with mana value 0 or less, including lands, currently on the battlefield or that are put onto the battlefield to be put into their owner's graveyard as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
